Everything you need

Built for developers who ship

From CLI to cloud, JoyTree gives you the full stack — deployment, databases, analytics, AI, and more — all in one place.

Command Line

Deploy from your terminal, instantly

The JoyTree CLI puts the full platform in your command line. Deploy a GitHub repo, trigger redeploys, manage API keys, stream live logs, and set env vars — without touching a browser. Every command you need, nothing you don't.

joytree deploy --static autodeploy v1.4.11
cmd.exe — joytree
joytree.site/dashboard — Analytics

Analytics

Real-time deployment intelligence

Track every deployment across your entire platform — success rates, build durations, top projects by deploy count, and live failure alerts. Cumulative charts and build-speed breakdowns give you the signal you actually need to ship faster.

build time success rate history

Flexible Runtimes

Every service type. One platform.

Deploy static sites, persistent web services, custom Dockerfiles, background workers, cron jobs, and more — all from the same dashboard. Switch between projects, manage domains, and access every tool from a clean, organised sidebar.

static site web service dockerfile worker cron

Database Support

Eight database engines. Zero friction.

Provision a managed JoyTree database or connect any external one — MongoDB Atlas, Firebase Realtime DB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, MariaDB, or Redis. Pull live schemas, run queries, browse data, and compare databases side by side, all without leaving the dashboard.

MongoDB PostgreSQL Firebase Redis MySQL Supabase

AI Integration · MCP

Control JoyTree directly from Claude

JoyTree's Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposes your entire platform as tools Claude can call. Deploy a repo, spin up a database, compare migrations, set env vars, stream logs — all by describing what you want in plain English inside Claude.ai.

MCP server Claude.ai 23 tools natural language
Every language and database, ready to go

Node.js on Joytree

Use Node.js for APIs, dashboards, and real-time apps. Joytree auto-builds, starts runtime containers, and streams logs live during rollout.

Python on Joytree

Ship Flask/FastAPI backends with custom start commands. Joytree gives isolated runtime, subdomains, and one-click redeploy from GitHub.

Java on Joytree

Deploy Spring or JVM services with controlled build/start steps and environment variables. Monitor every stage through professional live logs.

Go on Joytree

Run efficient Go services with minimal setup. Joytree handles routing, TLS edge integration, and revision-style redeploy flows.

.NET on Joytree

Build and run .NET services with explicit install/build/start commands and managed deployment history, health visibility, and fast rollback paths.

Platform capabilities

One platform. Deploy, store, generate, and ship.

Everything a modern product needs — from first commit to live API — with zero DevOps knowledge required.

GitHub Deployments
Connect any public or private repo. Authenticate with a Personal Access Token, choose your branch, configure your build — and deploy on demand with one click.
Git + PAT Auth
No-GitHub Upload Deploy
No repo needed. Drop a ZIP, tar.gz, or single HTML file, extract it in the browser-side IDE, and deploy straight to a live subdomain. Perfect for quick prototypes or client handoffs.
ZIP · tar.gz · HTML
Managed Databases
Spin up isolated Redis, MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL instances in seconds. Each database gets its own container, memory cap, and connection string — ready to wire into any project.
Redis · Mongo · MySQL · Postgres
AI API Builder
Describe what your API should do in plain English. Joytree AI generates a live, containerised REST API endpoint instantly — with a response template, follow-up prompt support, and a public URL.
Joytree AI v2
Real-time Build Logs
An Xterm.js-powered terminal streams every line of your build as it happens — install, compile, copy, live. No waiting, no polling, no refresh. Pure transparency from first byte to deployment.
Socket.io + Xterm.js
Docker Build Isolation
Every build and every database runs in its own fresh container. No dependency leakage, no shared state between projects. Clean disk after every build, even on failures.
Docker · Zero waste
Browser-side Code IDE
Upload a ZIP and open it in the built-in IDE — browse files, edit code, and redeploy without leaving your browser. No local toolchain, no terminal, no Git required.
In-browser IDE
Instant Rollbacks
Every deployment is versioned. One click takes your site back to any previous successful build — no re-cloning, no re-building, just a clean pointer swap.
Version history
Platform walkthrough

Four powerful tools. One dashboard.

Everything from code to database to live API — explained in plain steps.

01
Deploy via GitHub or file upload
Paste a repo URL or drop a ZIP file. Configure build commands, output directory, Node.js version, and env vars — then hit Deploy to go live at your own subdomain.
02
Spin up a managed database
Create a Redis, MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL instance with one click. Pick your memory size, get a connection string, and wire it into your project — all without touching a terminal.
03
Generate a live API with AI
Describe the API you need in plain English. Joytree AI builds and deploys a containerised REST endpoint instantly — with a public URL, response template, and follow-up prompt support.
04
Monitor, redeploy, and rollback
Every deployment streams live logs in a real terminal. One-click redeploys and instant rollbacks keep you in control — no downtime, no guessing, no DevOps knowledge needed.
deploy.sh
database.json
api-prompt.txt
rollback.sh
# Deploy via API — GitHub or upload curl -X POST https://joytree.site/api/deploy \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "my-react-app", "subdomain": "myapp", "repoUrl": "https://github.com/user/repo", "branch": "main", "buildCmd": "npm run build", "outputDir": "dist" }' # ✓ Live at myapp.joytree.site in ~30s # Or upload a ZIP — no GitHub needed
// Managed database — created instantly { "type": "redis", "name": "session-cache", "memoryMb": 256, "status": "running", "host": "localhost", "port": 6380, "password": "<auto-generated>" } // Also supports: MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL // Wire straight into your project env vars
# Plain-English API prompt — Joytree AI "Create a REST API that returns a list of 10 trivia questions with answers, categorised by difficulty level. Include a /random endpoint that picks one." # Joytree generates + deploys instantly: # GET /api/live/flow_1780257588074 # GET /api/live/flow_1780257588074/random # Full JSON response. Public URL. No code.
# Instant rollback — no rebuild needed curl -X POST https://joytree.site/api/projects/myapp/rollback \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \ -d '{ "deployId": "prev-deploy-abc" }' # Response: { ok: true, rolledBackTo: "prev-deploy-abc" } # Site live on previous version in seconds # Zero downtime. Zero re-cloning.
Under the hood

Code → Build → Database → API → Live.

1
Source In
GitHub repo clone or ZIP/HTML upload — your choice, same result.
2
Isolated Build
Fresh Docker container: install → build → copy output. Live logs stream to your terminal throughout.
3
Database
Optionally attach a Redis, MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL instance — running in its own container with auto-generated credentials.
4
AI API
Describe your API in plain English — Joytree AI generates and deploys a live REST endpoint in seconds, no code required.
5
Subdomain Routing
Nginx maps your-project.joytree.site to the right output folder automatically — SSL included, zero config.
6
Live
Your app, database, and API are all running. One-click redeploy or rollback any time from the dashboard.

Upload Deploy API
Deploy a ZIP archive — no GitHub needed
HTTP

Help & Guides

Realtime API Builder (New)

            

              

                
1. Describe your API in natural language

                Open Realtime API Builder, write what your API should do, and choose Joytree AI v1 or v2.
              

              

                
2. Generate, deploy, and test instantly

                Joytree generates routes, logic, and response templates, then deploys live with a URL you can call immediately from your app.
              

              

                
3. Apply follow-up prompts

                Update the same API in place (pagination, filters, validation, response shape) without rebuilding from scratch.
              

              

                
4. Seed data and evolve fast

                Seed records, inspect generated response behavior, and iterate quickly using your API detail panel and live actions.

Troubleshooting

            

              
Build fails at install step — Check that your repo has a valid package.json. Try npm install as install command.

              
Build succeeds but site shows 404 — Your output directory is wrong. Check the table above for your framework's correct output folder.

              
Site shows "not deployed yet" — The build succeeded but the subdomain hasn't been visited yet. Wait 30 seconds and try again.

              
Screenshot not loading — Screenshots take 10–15 seconds to generate. If still missing after a redeploy, the screenshot service may be temporarily unavailable.

              
Status stuck on building — Refresh the page. If it persists, the build timed out — check the logs and redeploy.

Built by developers

          
A Message From Our Founders

          
Why JOYTREE exists, who is building it, and the vision driving the platform forward.

        

      

      

        

          
At JOYTREE, our mission started with a simple question:

          
How can we build technology that truly profits and empowers the tech ecosystem across Ghana, Africa, and the global developer community?

          
As developers, we watched a new generation of brilliant creators rise every single day. We also saw them get bogged down, frustrated, and stressed by the massive hurdles of DevOps—spending hours configuring servers, managing keys, and setting up environments just to get a simple application running. We knew there had to be a better way.

          
That is why we built JOYTREE. We wanted to completely eliminate that friction.

          
Today, JOYTREE allows upcoming and seasoned developers alike to spin up a fully deployed, callable, Docker-backed API endpoint from scratch—just by typing a single prompt. We have combined this with an instant database system that lets you provision and ship databases in seconds, seamlessly integrating them with your projects along with instant API key management.

          
We handle the heavy lifting behind the scenes so you can focus entirely on writing code and building the future.

Just bought a fresh domain?

            

              Fresh domains come with default nameservers at your registrar. Two options:


              Option A - Move to Cloudflare (recommended):

              1. Add your domain at cloudflare.com (free plan)

              2. Copy the 2 nameservers Cloudflare gives you

              3. Paste them at your registrar under "Custom Nameservers"

              4. Wait up to 24h, then add the CNAME record above in Cloudflare DNS

              5. Set Proxy status to Proxied (orange cloud) for instant SSL


              Option B - Stay at your registrar:

              1. Log into your registrar DNS panel

              2. Add a CNAME record as shown in the table above

              3. Set TTL to lowest available (300 or Auto)

              4. Wait up to 48h for propagation
            

          

          
          

            
Using a subdomain (app.yourdomain.com)?

            

              Set Name to just the prefix — e.g. app for app.yourdomain.com. Not the full URL.


              Free subdomain services (dpdns.org, duckdns.org, afraid.org etc.) control their own DNS zone — add the CNAME through their dashboard, not Cloudflare.
            

          

          
DNS propagation: under 5 min with Cloudflare proxied • up to 48h with other registrars

Import External Site

        
Serve any live website through your JoyTree project URL — useful when migrating from Vercel, Railway, Render, or any other host.

      

      

        

          
How it works

          

            1. You pick a JoyTree project (e.g. myapp.joytree.site)

            2. You enter the URL of the external site (e.g. myapp.vercel.app)

            3. JoyTree proxies all traffic — visitors to your JoyTree URL see the external site's content

            4. You can remove the import any time and your project's own deployment takes over again
          

        

      

      

        

          

            
1

            
Select JoyTree project
Traffic to this project's URL will be forwarded to the external site

          

        

        

          

            

              Select a project...
              
            

            

              
Select a project...

            

            
          

          

        

      

      

        

          

            
2

            
Enter the external site URL
The live website you want to mirror — from any host or platform

          

        

        

          
          
Examples: myapp.vercel.app • myproject.up.railway.app • myapp.onrender.com

          

            
Routing preview

will see content from —

            How to connect
          

          

            
1. Generate a key — click New Key, pick a label and project, click Generate.

            
2. Download the private key — save as ~/.ssh/joytree_id_ed25519

            
3. Set permissions — run chmod 600 ~/.ssh/joytree_id_ed25519

            
4. Connect — paste the SSH command into your terminal or VS Code Remote-SSH.

            
Host joytree
  HostName YOUR_DOMAIN
  User root
  Port 22
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/joytree_id_ed25519

Recreate Database

        
Rebuilds the container from scratch

      

    

    

      Recreate ?
    

    

      Use this if the database won't start even after Restart — Restart only relaunches the existing container, so it can't fix things baked in at creation time (memory limits, engine config, etc). Recreate removes the container and provisions a fresh one with the same name, credentials, and connection details, so nothing else needs to be updated afterward.

Your privacy, plainly explained

        
Before you continue, please review how JoyTree handles your data.

      

    


    

      
What we collect

      
To run your account and deployments, we collect:

      
    
        
  • Account details — your name, email address, and a securely hashed password (or your GitHub/Google identity if you sign in that way).
    • 
        
  • GitHub data — with your permission, repository names and contents you choose to deploy, plus enough OAuth scope to clone and redeploy on your behalf.
    • 
        
  • Your project data — source code, build logs, environment variables, and database contents you create or upload. Environment variables are encrypted at rest.
    • 
        
  • Billing information — handled directly by Paystack; we store only the plan you're on and a transaction reference, never your full card details.
    • 
        
  • Usage & diagnostic data — deployment timestamps, request/response logs for your hosted apps, IP address, and browser type, used to keep the platform reliable and secure.
    • 
      


      
How we use it

      
Strictly to operate JoyTree: authenticating you, building and running your deployments, routing traffic to your apps, billing your chosen plan, sending deployment/security notifications, and diagnosing platform issues. We do not sell your data, and we do not read your project source code except when required to debug a build failure you've reported, or when legally compelled to.


      
Cookies & similar technology

      
We use a small number of cookies and browser storage entries:

      
    
        
  • Essential — session/auth tokens that keep you signed in. The platform cannot function without these.
    • 
        
  • Preference — your theme choice (dark/light) and this consent decision itself.
    • 
        
  • Analytics — anonymized usage patterns that help us find bugs and improve the dashboard. These are the only ones affected by the choice below.
    • 
      


      
Who we share data with

      
We rely on a small set of infrastructure providers to run JoyTree, each bound by their own data-processing terms: Firebase (account & workspace storage), Cloudflare (routing, DDoS protection, SSL), GitHub (repository access you explicitly grant), and Paystack (payment processing). None of these providers use your data for their own advertising.


      
Your rights

      
You can request a copy of your data, ask us to correct it, or delete your account and everything tied to it — including your deployed containers and stored files — at any time from Settings, or by emailing us. Deletion is permanent and typically completes within 24 hours.


      
Data retention

      
Account and project data is kept for as long as your account is active. Build logs are retained for 90 days. If you delete a project or your account, associated containers, files, and database contents are removed from our infrastructure — not just hidden from the dashboard.


      
Children's privacy

      
JoyTree is not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect data from them.


      
Changes to this policy

      
If we make a material change to how we handle your data, we'll show this notice again rather than quietly updating a page you'll never revisit.


      
Effective from Aug 2026 · Questions? support@joytree.app
